_comment: Built-in defaults for every dropdown list and threshold.
The application reads a value from the Settings tab of the Google Sheet when
a row exists for it, and falls back to the value here when it does not. So a
fresh Sheet works immediately, and Chintan can still change any list from the
Settings page without a code change.
`fixed: true` marks a list the specification does not allow to be changed
(areas, section 4.1) or that the code itself matches against (source types,
roles). Those are shown read-only on the Settings page.

areas.label: Areas
areas.description: The three areas used in every area dropdown. Fixed by the specification.

sourceTypes.label: Source types
sourceTypes.description: Collection source keys. Stored in the Sheet and matched in code, so these cannot be renamed.

roles.label: User roles
roles.description: The two user types. The permission checks compare against these exact words.

states.label: States and union territories
states.description: Indian states and union territories, for the vendor address.
values: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

wasteStreams.label: Waste streams
wasteStreams.description: The five waste streams. Change these only alongside the waste category master.

vendorTypes.label: Vendor types
vendorTypes.description: What kind of service provider a vendor is. "Others" shows a free-text box on the form.

bwgTypes.label: BWG types
bwgTypes.description: What kind of bulk waste generator. "Others" shows a free-text box on the form.

operationTypes.label: Operation types
operationTypes.description: Which streams a BWG or MMRF handles.

collectionFrequencies.label: Collection frequencies
collectionFrequencies.description: How often a BWG is collected from. For information only — it does not restrict inward entry.

agreementTypes.label: Agreement types
agreementTypes.description: The financial arrangement with a BWG.

mouTypes.label: MoU types
mouTypes.description: A fixed-term MoU asks for an end date and raises an expiry alert.

dispatchPurposes.label: Dispatch purposes
dispatchPurposes.description: Why waste was dispatched. Anything other than Disposal counts as landfill diversion.

financials.label: Dispatch financials
financials.description: Who pays whom on a dispatch. No rate or amount is recorded.

vehicleTypes.label: Vehicle types
vehicleTypes.description: An Electric vehicle hides the PUC validity field.

collectedByOptions.label: Special collection — collected by
collectedByOptions.description: Whether a special collection was done by a vendor or an RRR vehicle.
